monitored_routes.name: Interstate 80 (Donner Pass)
monitored_routes.description: Primary trans-Sierra artery linking the Bay Area & Sacramento to Lake Tahoe, Truckee, and Reno.
monitored_routes.critical_hazards: Whiteouts, gale-force pass winds, spinouts between Cisco Grove and Donner Summit.
monitored_routes.polyline_source: OSRM routed on OpenStreetMap road network

monitored_routes.name: State Route 89 North (River Road)
monitored_routes.description: Essential access corridor to Olympic Valley (Palisades Tahoe) and Alpine Meadows from I-80 and Lake Tahoe.
monitored_routes.critical_hazards: Heavy ski commute traffic, icy canyon corners, river canyon drifting snow.
monitored_routes.polyline_source: OSRM routed on OpenStreetMap road network

monitored_routes.name: State Route 89 South (West Shore / Emerald Bay)

typical_checkpoints.southbound: D.L. Bliss State Park / Meeks Bay

monitored_routes.description: Scenic west shore route connecting North Lake Tahoe with South Lake Tahoe via Emerald Bay.
monitored_routes.critical_hazards: Active avalanche chutes over steep cliffs. Frequently CLOSED during significant storm cycles.
monitored_routes.polyline_source: OSRM routed on OpenStreetMap road network

monitored_routes.name: State Route 267 (Brockway Summit)
monitored_routes.description: Direct route between Truckee and Kings Beach / Northstar California.
monitored_routes.critical_hazards: Steep grade over Brockway Summit with fast-accumulating snow and icy descents.
monitored_routes.polyline_source: OSRM routed on OpenStreetMap road network

monitored_routes.name: State Route 28 (North Lake Blvd)
monitored_routes.description: Lakeside route connecting Tahoe City, Carnelian Bay, Kings Beach, and Incline Village.
monitored_routes.critical_hazards: Slush and freezing spray near lake level; heavy local resort transit.
monitored_routes.polyline_source: OSRM routed on OpenStreetMap road network

monitored_routes.name: U.S. Highway 50 (Echo Summit)
monitored_routes.description: Southern Sierra access highway linking Sacramento, Placerville, Sierra-at-Tahoe, and South Lake Tahoe.
monitored_routes.critical_hazards: Echo Summit rockfall, avalanches, and steep tight hairpins coming down into Tahoe Basin.
monitored_routes.polyline_source: OSRM routed on OpenStreetMap road network

monitored_routes.name: Nevada State Route 28 (East Shore)
monitored_routes.description: East shore of Lake Tahoe from Incline Village past Sand Harbor to US-50 at Spooner Junction.
monitored_routes.feed_note: Nevada road: Caltrans has no data for it, and NDOT's Nevada 511 feed needs a developer key, which is not connected.
monitored_routes.polyline_source: OSRM routed on OpenStreetMap road network; high point from USGS EPQS

monitored_routes.name: U.S. Highway 50 (Southeast Shore / Spooner Summit)
monitored_routes.description: Southeast shore of Lake Tahoe from South Lake Tahoe through Stateline, Zephyr Cove and Glenbrook to Spooner Summit.
monitored_routes.feed_note: Caltrans covers only the California part (South Lake Tahoe to Stateline); the Nevada part (Stateline to Spooner Summit) has no live feed.
monitored_routes.polyline_source: OSRM routed on OpenStreetMap road network; high point from USGS EPQS

monitored_routes.name: Olympic Valley Road (Palisades Access)
monitored_routes.description: 2.1-mile designated access spur from SR-89 directly into The Village at Palisades Tahoe.
monitored_routes.critical_hazards: Morning parking queues, morning snowplow operations.
monitored_routes.polyline_source: OSRM routed on OpenStreetMap road network

monitored_routes.name: Alpine Meadows Road (Alpine Access)
monitored_routes.description: 3.5-mile winding alpine canyon road ascending from River Ranch on SR-89 up to Alpine Meadows Base Lodge.
monitored_routes.critical_hazards: Steep canyon walls, icy switchbacks, active avalanche monitoring zones.
monitored_routes.polyline_source: OSRM routed on OpenStreetMap road network
